notes: The 50 A / 250 V values are the SB50 IEC ratings, not the higher UL wire-to-wire current rating.

This catalog part represents a reviewed wire-to-wire mated assembly using blue 992G4 housings and 5900 high-force 6 AWG contacts; it is not a claim that the housing alone carries the electrical rating.
The IEC information identifies 16 mm^2 wire and contact series 5900/1307 as the tested configuration and states 5000-cycle life under IEC 60512 Test 9a.
The separate general silver-contact no-load 10000-cycle figure is intentionally not substituted for the IEC configuration's 5000-cycle result.
